# MetaSync for Confluence — Documentation

MetaSync documents a Salesforce org into Confluence on a schedule: objects, fields, flows, Apex, profiles, permission sets, layouts, reports and more, with change-impact analysis, an entity-relationship diagram and access-review reports. **One-way and read-only. Metadata, never records. Least privilege.**
